tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Every other surface sits on it. Text on it: ink, body, muted, faint.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Inputs, kanban columns, code, upload zones. ink, body and muted read on it; faint only just (4.5:1).

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, neutral chip ground, the app ground behind a shell. muted and chip-ink read on it; NEVER faint (4.35:1 fails).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary fills, links, the selected row rule. 21:1 on ground. A primary button is ink with ground text.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Reading text on ground, well and wash (12.6, 12.1, 11.6:1).

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on a neutral chip (wash): 8.9:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, labels, placeholders on ground, well and wash (5.7, 5.5, 5.3:1).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Meta text on pure ground ONLY (4.7:1). 4.5:1 on well; fails on wash. Never on a tint.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel and card borders. Decoration, 1.3:1: never text, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row rules in tables, the progress track, a column border.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: The border of an input.

tokens.name: console
tokens.usage: The outer line of a console box and a secondary button border.

tokens.name: decor
tokens.usage: Separators and disabled marks (2.5:1). Never a word.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one orange, as a mark only: a 6-8px square, a running state, the dot on a monogram, a focus outline. 3.4:1 on ground: text only from 24px.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: An orange WORD (5.2:1 on ground). Everything else orange is signal.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on ok-bg (5.2:1) and on ground (5.5:1): done, live, pass.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of an ok chip or notice. Ink: ok-ink.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: The 1px line of an ok chip or notice.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on warn-bg (6.8:1): needs action, silent, waiting.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of a warn chip or notice. Ink: warn-ink.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: The 1px line of a warn chip or notice.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on danger-bg (5.9:1) and on ground (6.5:1): failed, refused, overdue.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of a danger chip or notice. Ink: danger-ink.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: The 1px line of a danger chip or notice.

tokens.name: mark-ok
tokens.usage: A 6-8px square beside the word "done / live / pass". 2.5:1 on ground: it fails 3:1, so it is NEVER alone.

tokens.name: mark-warn
tokens.usage: A 6-8px square beside a word like "needs action". 2.2:1: never alone.

tokens.name: mark-danger
tokens.usage: A 6-8px square beside a word like "failed". 4.8:1; still paired with its word.

tokens.name: mark-none
tokens.usage: A square for "none / never seen" (hollow for never seen). 2.5:1: never alone.

tokens.name: id-1
tokens.usage: Identity mark by POSITION 1 (first column, first entity type, first series). A mark or a 2-3px rule, never a fill under text, never text.

tokens.name: id-2
tokens.usage: Identity mark, position 2. Marks only. 5.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: id-3
tokens.usage: Identity mark, position 3. Marks only. 5.7:1 on ground.

tokens.name: id-4
tokens.usage: Identity mark, position 4. Marks only. 5.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: id-5
tokens.usage: Identity mark, position 5. Marks only. 3.8:1 on ground.

tokens.name: id-6
tokens.usage: Identity mark, position 6. Marks only. Cycles back to id-1 after six.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The app bar: black in light, white in dark. Ink on it: bar-ink.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the app bar (21:1).

tokens.name: bar-field
tokens.usage: A search field on the app bar.

tokens.name: bar-line
tokens.usage: A 1px line on the app bar and the monogram border.

families.sans: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A section heading under a 1px black rule.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Chốt danh sách trưng bày Tết cho Co.opmart

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Công việc và tài liệu, một cửa.
styles.usage: Reading text. Line height 1.6: stacked Vietnamese diacritics collide below 1.5.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Chỉ tính các lượt kiểm tra trên bảng bạn xem được.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name in the app bar, uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, table headers, field labels. Set uppercase, in muted, with an orange square before a section label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a segmented switch; between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The padding of a console box; the gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; the gap between a column header and its cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter minimum; card gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding (20-30px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between sections of a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The monogram; large section gaps.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The desktop app bar (56px on a phone).

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: The minimum touch target (48px for a phone screen's main action).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, cards, buttons, inputs, chips, tables, modals. There is no other radius for UI.

tokens.name: radius-monogram
tokens.usage: The product monogram only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: An avatar (a person), a toggle knob, a status dot that is explicitly a dot, the orange dot on the monogram.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Depth is a 1px line (line, console, or a 1px black border on a popover). No box-shadow, no blur, no glass.
